raw_evidence_policy: Preserved on disk: ROS bags, Simu5G scalar and vector evidence, exported network metrics, bridge logs, run datasets and audits. Simu5G vector and raw metric files are gzip-compressed; the B1_PILOT_001 input is kept directly readable as the reference example.
git_policy: Datasets, scalars, manifests, configuration, traces and audits are tracked. Bulk regenerable output (.mcap bag payloads, .vec vectors, raw metric dumps) is excluded by size and checksummed in raw_evidence_manifest.json.
